requirement: When a user submits an incorrect password for an existing account, the login API shall return HTTP 401.
The file-upload API shall reject any file larger than 10,485,760 bytes with HTTP 413.
When an authenticated user requests their profile through GET /profile, the API shall return HTTP 200 with a JSON object containing that user’s stored display_name and email values.
For each successful card payment, the payments service shall store a receipt containing the transaction ID, amount in minor currency units, and ISO 4217 currency code.
When an administrator sends a message to an account owner, the dashboard shall display their name beside the message.
The transaction report shall list payments made during the last month.
The notification service shall send a reminder 24 hours before the appointment unless it is disabled.
The search endpoint shall return the first 10 matching products ordered by price.
The checkout page shall be easy to use for first-time customers.
The dashboard shall load quickly after the user signs in.
The mobile application’s notification sounds shall be pleasant to users.
The audit service shall retain each login event for a specified retention period.
When a user selects Export on the monthly sales report, the system shall generate a file in the required format.
The profile API shall reject a display name with HTTP 400 if its length exceeds the configured maximum, which has not yet been specified.
The login API shall return HTTP 401 for an incorrect password, and the reports API shall return monthly sales totals in CSV format.
The profile page shall display the user’s stored display name, and the admin dashboard shall display the total number of registered accounts.
The storage service shall losslessly encode every possible 1,024-byte file into a payload of at most 512 bytes and reconstruct the original file solely from that payload.
The recovery service shall reconstruct every possible 1 MiB file solely from its 256-bit hash, without access to any other information about the file.
The platform shall process payments instantly and generate useful reports.
The mobile application shall automatically notify them when appropriate and keep every user’s profile up to date.
